hooks.command: sh -c 'if command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1; then powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$HOME/.claude/hooks/maestro-guard.ps1"; else bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/maestro-guard.sh"; fi'

sh -c 'if command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1; then powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$HOME/.claude/hooks/verify-prompt.ps1"; else bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/verify-prompt.sh"; fi'
